默认1分，使用0–100分制；新目标领先超过此值立即切换。: Default: one point on a 0–100 scale. Switch immediately when a challenger leads by more than this value.
旧版保留15°单点朝向及相对最高伤害排序，忽略新增扣分和稳定规则；保存的新参数不: Legacy preserves the 15-degree point-facing score and relative maximum damage. New deductions and stabilization are ignored without erasing saved settings.
综合分由威胁分与我方伤害分加权。新版威胁考虑对方视线与自身完整Hitbox、对方: Total score combines threat and outgoing damage. The new model uses the target's direction relative to your full hitboxes, incoming weapon damage, low ammo and reload deductions.
仅对有效弹匣弹量小于等于1扣分；大于1或未知均不扣，未知会标记降级。: Deduct only for known valid magazine counts of one or less. Larger or unknown counts incur no deduction; unknown data marks the score as degraded.
确认正在换弹时扣分，可与低弹量扣分叠加；威胁分最低为0。: Deduct for confirmed reloading, together with any low-ammo deduction. Threat never falls below zero.
分值=100×预计伤害÷(预计伤害+受击者当前血量)。保留未封顶原始伤害；关闭时: Score = 100 × damage / (damage + recipient health). Raw uncapped damage is retained. Disable to compare with relative maximum damage.
当前目标仍有效且新目标领先不超过切换分差时保持当前目标；死亡、失效或明显更高分立: Keep a valid current target when a challenger leads by no more than the switch margin. Reconsider immediately on death, invalidity or a larger lead. Each target still uses its highest-damage bone.
所有分值为0–100；公式随已保存的设置更新。: Scores range from 0 to 100. Formulas reflect saved settings.
夹角是敌方视线与“敌方视点→我的视点”方向的夹角；未知朝向按0分计算。: The angle is between the target's view direction and the direction from their viewpoint to yours. Unknown facing scores zero.
威胁分 = 限制到0–100({{aim}}% × 瞄准分 + {{incomi: Threat = clamp({{aim}}% × aim score + {{incoming}}% × incoming damage score − low ammo deduction − reload deduction, 0, 100)
限制到0–100：低于0取0，高于100取100。: Clamp to 0–100: values below zero become zero; values above 100 become 100.
视线命中我的任一Hitbox：100；背向或无可接近命中体：0；其余 = min: View ray intersects any of your hitboxes: 100. Facing away or no reachable hitbox: 0. Otherwise: min(99.9999, 100 / max(1, k)).
k是让射线触及自身命中体所需的最小尺寸放大倍数；越接近命中，瞄准分越高。: k is the smallest size expansion needed for the ray to reach one of your hitboxes. Closer aim scores higher.

敌方伤害分 = 100 × 敌方预计伤害 ÷ (敌方预计伤害 + 我的当前血量): Incoming score = 100 × incoming damage / (incoming damage + your health)
我方伤害分 = 100 × 我方预计伤害 ÷ 当前候选最高我方伤害: Outgoing score = 100 × outgoing damage / maximum outgoing damage among current candidates
敌方伤害分 = 100 × 敌方预计伤害 ÷ 当前候选最高敌方伤害: Incoming score = 100 × incoming damage / maximum incoming damage among current candidates

当前目标死亡或失效时立即重新选择。: Reselect immediately when the current target dies or becomes invalid.
旧版不使用低弹量、换弹扣分、健康归一化及目标保持规则。: Legacy ignores low ammo and reload deductions, health-aware scaling and target retention.
瞄准或敌伤数据缺失时，仅在已知且占比大于0的项之间重新分配比例；没有可用的威胁正: Missing aim or incoming damage: renormalize the known positive-weight terms. With no usable positive threat terms, total = outgoing damage score. Unknown ammo or reload state incurs no deduction.
有限采样全被掩体挡住不会直接清零威胁；只有已验证敌方完全无伤害能力才直接置0。: Blocked finite samples do not automatically zero threat. Only verified inability to deal any damage directly sets threat to zero.
